triton_cache_seed.key_policy: First source wins each complete key directory:39 tail-first keys,2 additional host-near-first fused_moe keys; never mix files of a key
triton_cache_seed.copy_policy: Independent copies per arm; group child_paths relocated to that arm; extern_libs and compiled bytes unchanged; no previous-arm cache feedback
triton_cache_seed.development_status: Already observed exploration data, not independent confirmation

resource_handoff.scope: Only first GPU boundary before model preflight/CUDA. Whole-group4800s includes initial clearance; later boundaries unchanged. One3600s shared-lock wait, no signals/automatic retry.

configuration.gpu_kv: Current Instruct normal .90 profile then pin same byte budget
configuration.arrival: Previously fixed 320 arrivals at i/100 s, source never waits for engine
configuration.task: One fixed instruction and official chat template around each full original article; no truncation
configuration.warmup: Existing 32x16 / 384x93 / 2 long x16 then native drain/reset
configuration.cache: Existing frozen private Triton seed, all other per-cell caches empty; JIT remains observable

primary: Exploratory feasibility of a real-summary completion service. All externally arrived mean completion flow; no policy improvement claim from one reference. Preserve full TTFT, flow, per-request maximum gaps, throughput, drain, failures, unfinished and output/quality.
slo: No application SLO; no post-hoc goodput threshold.
hypothesis: The old continuation reference has 256/256 unique legal candidates ending at their declared caps. Natural summary termination may remove pressure, or may expose a different controllable victim-choice problem.
claim_ceiling: One development-domain feasibility reference; not a policy intervention, independent confirmation, a revival of retired selectors, or cross-model strategy speedup.
decision_rule: If summaries fail the preselected content checks, predominantly truncate, or have no actual preemption/choice opportunity, stop this task-domain attempt without scanning load/capacity/prompt. If valid natural outputs leave concrete controllable loss under the simple reference, use recorded choices to design a bounded action test before a predictor.
quality_scope: Eight length-stratified request IDs fixed in workload.task.quality_check_ids before generation. Human-readable checks of supported facts/main points/coherence/continuation/repetition/truncation; no reference-summary score or claimed quality equivalence.

repeat_design.statistical_unit: One independent run; no uncertainty estimate or causal strategy contrast

runtime_scope: Victim selection remains the previously measured remaining_budget rule; all three existing shadow rules retained. No new scheduler, lease, trigger, transfer or admission controller. Only native_stop_reason metadata added without changing execution.
capacity_source: Fresh normal Instruct profile on this exact GPU; old base capacity not accepted.
retention: Keep both cells, all raw output, failure and incomplete results; no automatic retries, no extra waiter.
shared_budget_note: Expected5-8min whole GPU group; hard600s per cell/1200s group including profile and startup; inherited single3600s shared-lock wait and300s initial handoff. No expense telemetry or known shared remaining balance.

lock_identity_observed_before_launch.semantics: Read only before freeze; actual lock/process/GPU checked again by the existing controller.
